#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int N = 20;
const double eps = 1e-10;

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &k);
    vector<double> a(n);
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        scanf("%lf", &a[i]);
        if (a[i] < eps) ++cnt;
    }
    k = min(n - cnt, k);
    vector<double> p(1 << n, 0.0);
    vector<double> res(n, 0.0);
    p[0] = 1.0;
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        double suma = 0.0;
        bool ok = true;
        int cnt = 0;
        int m = mask;
        while (m) {
            int i = __builtin_ctz(m);
            suma += a[i];
            if (a[i] < eps) ok = false;
            ++cnt;
            m &= m - 1;
        }
        if (!ok) {
            p[mask] = 0.0;
            continue;
        }
        double sump = 0.0;
        m = mask;
        while (m) {
            int i = __builtin_ctz(m);
            sump += a[i] / (1.0 - suma + a[i]) * p[mask ^ (1 << i)];
            m &= m - 1;
        }
        p[mask] = sump;
        if (cnt == k) {
            m = mask;
            while (m) {
                int i = __builtin_ctz(m);
                res[i] += p[mask];
                m &= m - 1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        printf("%.10f%c", res[i], " \n"[i == n - 1]);
    return 0;
}
